mentions.name: jetbrains-mini-agent
mentions.description: This is a fully offline LLM coding agent plug-in for JetBrains IDEs, designed to run with local models such as Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf on an RTX 3090 or better GPU. The source code is intentionally kept short so it can be easily audited if needed.
